entities.rationale: Blue hand-drawn TV/monitor on the left with the notes 'Logs, Perf, User' beneath it; represents the VIZIO smart TVs emitting log, performance and user data. Not inside any box.

entities.name: Kinesis
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'KINESIS' (AWS_Icon_3 at 794,404). Standalone, no container; ingests the data stream from the TVs.

entities.name: Kinesis Firehose
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'KINESIS FIREHOSE' (AWS_Icon_5 at 1020,205). Standalone, no container; delivers the stream to Redshift and S3.

entities.name: Redshift
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'REDSHIFT' (AWS_Icon_4 at 1289,210). Standalone, no container; data warehouse fed by Firehose.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_1 at 1025,523). Standalone, no container; storage destination fed by Firehose.

entities.name: QuickSight
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'QUICKSIGHT' (AWS_Icon_2 at 1294,485). Standalone, no container; visualization layer below Redshift.
